program.name: Upper/Lower Power
program.subject: Strength
program.blurb: Alternating upper and lower days built from supersets: two exercises back to back, then rest.
program.about: Upper and lower days built from supersets: two exercises back to back, then rest. Pairing moves fits more work into the time and keeps the heart rate up. Level II slows the lowering to three seconds and Level III brings harder variations. Suits you if straight sets feel slow.
